findings.text: follow-on: the fourth-order central-tangent weight limits the vertical moment and toroidal stress to second order because the analytic separatrix places a vertex on the X-point corner, where the tangent stencil is off by order one; contour-ladder.log shows their 501-point departure rising from 7.3e-7 and 3.0e-5 under the chord rule to 3.4e-5 and 3.4e-5 under the new rule, so a coarse-sampling caller sees a worse secondary moment; disclosed in the report caveat and still under the bound, so it does not hold the node.

follow-on: the new guard compares the radial moment of the same function at two samplings, so a regression that shifts the moment by a sampling-independent amount leaves the departure under 1e-5 and passes; it catches the chord-rule class, shown by suite-head-with-new-test.log, but is not independent of the compared quantity.
